name: Electron Main and Renderer Isolation
description: Enforce process isolation between the Electron main process and renderer processes. Renderer processes must have no direct Node.js access, no require(), no process.binding, and no direct filesystem or network access from renderer context.
purpose: Prevent renderer compromise from escalating to full host access by enforcing strict main/renderer process boundaries with no direct Node.js capabilities exposed to renderer contexts.
acceptanceCriteria: No renderer process has access to require(), module, process.binding, or __dirname
Preload scripts do not leak Node.js primitives to the renderer
Audit confirms no renderer process can import native modules or access the filesystem
